Art for the room it will live in

I am Omaste Witkowski, a Washington State artist. Before I made art I was an architectural photographer, and the aim has not changed: an image should complement the space it hangs in, and make it better.

My work is handblown glass photographed from a thumb's width away, landscapes of named places in the Methow Valley and the North Cascades, and abstracts built in layers. Every piece is printed to order by Fine Art America on canvas, metal, acrylic or paper, in the size your wall needs.
